techniqueLessons: Silhouette expansion is concentrated vertically and at role-defining costume zones instead of enclosing the body in a rectangular cage.
Added geometry is spent selectively on authored costume systems and transitions rather than equal-sized plates everywhere.
The texture uses a broad tonal range and clear material/value separation instead of flat equipment swatches.
Dedicated animation and poser assets show that costume-heavy variants should be treated as motion-aware packages rather than bind-pose sculptures.
distinctiveElementsNotToCopy: The exact Captain outfit silhouette, hat/headwear, uniform motifs, palette placement, proprietary geometry, UV layout and recognizable costume detailing.

references.project: Styles Upon Styles - Cobblemon Costume Pack
references.requiredAttribution: Study-only in Ouros because NC/SA compatibility with final distribution has not been approved; no geometry, texture, palette or motif is copied.
techniqueLessons: Strong costume identity can come from articulated grouping and plane orientation rather than maximizing primitive count.
One-sided silhouette distribution can create role-specific asymmetry while preserving intentional negative space.
A separate sparse alpha layer demonstrates clean separation of secondary visual treatment from the biological surface.
A dedicated resolver aspect keeps presentation routing explicit instead of relying on implicit model mutation.
distinctiveElementsNotToCopy: The exact lifeguard costume, rescue equipment, outfit silhouette, color blocking, markings, authored geometry, UV arrangement and recognizable design language.

techniqueLessons: A high proportion of rotated primitives can produce aggressive contour changes without relying on orthogonal slabs.
A single dominant prop/system can carry the silhouette more effectively than evenly distributed hardware around the whole body.
A broad value range and many visible colors create stronger material breakup than flat accessory swatches.
Large attached systems require motion-aware validation through dedicated battle/idle presentation, not only parent-chain correctness.
distinctiveElementsNotToCopy: The Guts/Berserk identity, sword, costume silhouette, manga-derived motifs, exact proportions, palette, markings, model geometry, texture artwork and animation expression.

notes: All three counted references are non-canonical custom Lucario skins with materially changed geometry and distinct visual identities.
Mega Lucario assets, shiny variants and plain base remodels are excluded.
No third-party asset bytes are committed into Ouros production by this dossier.
